page.overview:
Who is Kenta Anwa?

Kenta Anwa was a male Silika. He once challenged Dannen Lifehold to the Contest, a drinking game. However, Lifehold was not affected by the Silika water, it had a much stronger affect on Anwa's species. Anwa was propelled by the defeat of Kemmel Attapi against Lifehold. He wagered a thousand-credit chip. After several mugs he fell on the floor, losing the Contest and his wager.
